units.source_text: 苗子急忙把围裙解下来，铺在地上。

en.t: Naeko hurriedly untied her apron and spread it on the ground.

units.source_text: 丹波棉布围裙很宽，直绕到她背后，因此足够她们两人并排坐下。

en.t: The Tanba cotton apron was very wide, wrapping all the way around to her back, so it was large enough for the two of them to sit side by side.
